Bug_Title: "ThreadLocal" variables should be cleaned up when no longer used
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the incorrectCleanup method where DELEGATE.set(null) is used instead of DELEGATE.remove(). This can lead to memory leaks as the ThreadLocal variable is not properly cleaned up.
Trigger_Explanation: The test triggers the bug by calling the showBug method on an instance of ThreadLocalUserSession. Inside showBug, the incorrectCleanup method is called, which sets the ThreadLocal variable to null instead of removing it, thus not cleaning up the ThreadLocal variable properly.
